consumptionData.methodology: Toyota publishes a WLTP combined range for the 1.8 Hybrid. The lower published combined value is retained for the selected efficient hatchback profile. Category rates are estimated: urban is kept low to reflect full-hybrid recuperation and electric assistance, interurban is near combined, motorway is higher for sustained engine operation, and unknown uses the selected combined value.

sources.title: Nuevo Toyota Corolla Hatchback híbrido
sources.notes: Used for 1.8 Hybrid 140 e-CVT and 4.4-4.7 L/100 km WLTP combined range.
